name: skill
description: A collection of independently installable Claude Code skills.

plugins.name: gh-pr-reply
plugins.description: Fetch a GitHub PR's review comments (humans + bots), apply valid fixes, and reply to every thread.

plugins.name: gh-pr-approve
plugins.description: Review a colleague's GitHub PR, then approve it or request changes and file follow-up issues.

plugins.name: statusline-kit
plugins.description: Install a Claude Code statusline (model, cwd/branch, context usage, session token totals) into a fresh environment.

plugins.name: skill-optimizer
plugins.description: Slim and restructure a SKILL.md without losing behavior, trigger coverage, anchors, or facts.

plugins.name: agent-clinic
plugins.description: Diagnose and treat a repo's context/doc health: trim bloated CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, resync public docs with the current code, untrack leaked editor config, and clear out finished planning artifacts.

plugins.name: agent-delegation
plugins.description: Delegate a GitHub issue to Claude Code CLI end to end: implement, open a PR, adversarially review, and loop re-delegation until every review comment is resolved.

plugins.name: agent-update
plugins.description: Install the latest claude-code native release directly, bypassing the built-in updater's fixed download deadline that fails on slow links: manifest lookup, resumable checksum-verified download, atomic symlink swap.

plugins.name: agent-dispatch
plugins.description: Advance a map issue's frontier: subagents self-grill every startable needs-triage sub-issue, the orchestrator decides what evidence settles and asks the human the rest, rewrites each issue as a ready-for-agent contract, dispatches implement or diagnosing-bugs subagents that open draft PRs, runs an adversarial reviewer in parallel with its final review of each PR, and keeps going as PRs merge until the map is done.
